title: Duality
subtitle: Two rows of Asscher, corner to corner, moving with the wrist.

stone.origin: Natural. Quarter-carat Asscher diamonds, two rows set edge-to-edge. 6.5 to 8.5 inch.

description: Two rows of Asscher-cut diamonds, set edge to edge and carried on the patented Bez Ambar Flex so the whole width moves with the wrist. The Asscher's step facets pull the eye downward into the stone; doubled and run in parallel, that depth repeats across the band, a broad field of squared light rather than a single line. Because the Flex has no hinge, the two rows pour around the wrist together as one supple surface. Made in eighteen-karat gold or platinum, to fit.
